title: AEF 1.0: checkpoint manifest
description: A release decision over several evidence lanes for one exact subject version: the lanes and their rules, the exact sealed runs each lane used (with their run hashes), the decision function's input and output once decided, and the state (CKP-1 to CKP-6).

schemaVersion.description: The AEF version this document follows, MAJOR.MINOR: 1.0 for AEF 1.0 (VER-1).

checkpointId.description: The checkpoint's id. A manifest is conventionally stored as checkpoints/<checkpointId>.json.

template.description: The template the checkpoint was made from.

ref.description: The template, as a typed reference.

subject.description: The exact version decided on. 'latest' is resolved before anything runs, and recorded: resolvedFrom says what was asked, version what it resolved to.

ref.description: The subject decided on, as a typed reference (CKP-1).

version.description: The exact version decided on; never latest (CKP-1).

image.description: The subject's OCI image manifest digest, when it is evaluated as an image.

deployment.description: Where the subject is deployed, as a typed reference.

resolvedFrom.description: What was asked for, such as latest, before it was resolved to version (CKP-1).

lanes.description: The evidence lanes, at least one, each named once (CKP-2).

lane.description: The lane's name, unique in the manifest (CKP-2).

rule.description: How the lane's result follows from its runs (CKP-2).

requirements.description: The external requirement ids the lane answers (CKP-2).

runs.description: The exact sealed runs this lane used; empty while pending.

blocking.description: A failed blocking lane blocks the release; a failed advisory lane is reported, never ignored.

freshness.description: The shortest freshness among the lane's requirements, resolved when the checkpoint was planned.

budget.description: What the checkpoint may spend, what it spent, and who approved it (CKP-6).

approvedUsd.description: The approved budget, in US dollars.

spentUsd.description: What has been spent so far, in US dollars.

approvedBy.description: Who approved the budget. A claim: a reader shows its assurance only as far as it verified it (CKP-6).

state.description: draft, planned, approved_to_spend, running, evidence_complete, then decided, in that order. An abandoned checkpoint moves to decided with the outcome aborted (CKP-4).

outcome.description: Set from state decided on; null before. approved, approved_with_exceptions, blocked, inconclusive or expired from the decision function (DEC-3); aborted when the checkpoint was abandoned (abortReason says why), never from the decision function (CKP-4).

decision.description: The decision function's output, recorded when the state became decided.

ext.description: Producer extensions, named reverse-DNS or with the producer's prefix. A reader ignores what it does not know; never holds a secret (ENC-19).

abortReason.description: Why the checkpoint was abandoned. Required with the outcome aborted (CKP-4).

decisionInput.description: The decision function's input, recorded with its output so anyone can recompute it; its exceptions are recorded here, so the checkpoint's signature covers them (CKP-4, CKP-5, CKP-7).

allOf.description: Decided by the decision function: its input and output are recorded.

outcome.description: With an outcome the decision function gave (CKP-4, DEC-3).

allOf.description: Abandoned: it says why, and records no decision.
From decided on, there is an outcome.

outcome.description: A decided checkpoint has an outcome (CKP-4).

allOf.description: Before the decision, there is none.

state.description: Applies before the checkpoint is decided (CKP-4).

outcome.description: Before decided, the outcome is null (CKP-4).

laneRule.description: What kind of rule a lane applies. A family with no published pass threshold takes comparison or evidence-present, never threshold.

kind.description: threshold: a summary entry against a value (LANE-2).

op.description: How the entry's value is compared with value, as binary64: >=, >, <= or < (LANE-2).

value.description: The threshold the entry's value is compared with (LANE-2).

suite.description: Only runs of this suite are eligible: the same ref, and the same version and digest for those given (LANE-1).

digest.description: The SHA-256 of its frozen content.

minimumN.description: The fewest measured lines the rule needs; fewer gives not_measured (LANE-2, LANE-3).

kind.description: severity: the worst severity allowed among failures (LANE-3).

max.description: The worst severity allowed among failures; a failure with no severity counts as critical (spec 05, LANE-3).

suite.description: Only runs of this suite are eligible: the same ref, and the same version and digest for those given (LANE-1).

digest.description: The SHA-256 of its frozen content.

minimumN.description: The fewest measured lines the rule needs; fewer gives not_measured (LANE-2, LANE-3).

kind.description: comparison: no significant regression of one run against a baseline run (LANE-5).

significance.description: The sign test's significance level, strictly between 0 and 1: the lane fails when p is at most this (LANE-8).

minimumPairs.description: The fewest untied pairs the test needs; with fewer, the result is not_measured (LANE-8).

axes.description: The comparability axes both runs must agree on (spec 05, LANE-6).

suite.description: Only runs of this suite are eligible: the same ref, and the same version and digest for those given (LANE-1).

digest.description: The SHA-256 of its frozen content.

kind.description: evidence-present: at least a number of eligible runs (LANE-4).

runs.description: At least this many eligible runs.

suite.description: Only runs of this suite are eligible: the same ref, and the same version and digest for those given (LANE-1).

digest.description: The SHA-256 of its frozen content.
